text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Crane games really are quite difficult, 
aren't they...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No, please don't let it bother you. If 
anything, I should be the one apologizing 
for being so selfish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I've rarely had the chance to 
visit a facility like this, so just 
looking around was plenty of fun."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Wanting a prize from a shop and not being 
able to get it was a fresh experience. 
Surely, this too is part of the true charm 
of crane games.
It ended in a disappointing result...
